title: raw_buf grows unbounded on persistent invalid UTF-8 input
description: client.rs SSE loop: when a chunk's bytes are never valid UTF-8 (e.g. 0xFF 0xFF repeated), valid_up_to==0 so raw_buf.drain(..0) drains nothing and text is empty. buf stays empty so the 1 MiB buf guard never fires, but raw_buf grows by every incoming chunk with no cap. A hostile server streaming persistent invalid UTF-8 causes unbounded memory growth and OOM. Fix: add a raw_buf.len() > limit guard alongside the buf guard, or share the same 1 MiB ceiling.
